description: Ground-truth adsorption properties for 5 published papers (7 material records), manually verified against the original publications. Includes one multi-material entry to validate schema v2 multi-record extraction.

papers.title: Exceptional chemical and thermal stability of zeolitic imidazolate frameworks
papers.source_hint: Park et al. (2006) — ZIF-8 N2 physisorption at 77 K. BET and pore volume from Table 1.

papers.title: Strategies for hydrogen storage in metal-organic frameworks
papers.source_hint: Rowsell & Yaghi (2005) — multi-material H2 storage comparison. HKUST-1 and MOF-177 BET from Tables 1–2.

papers.title: Systematic design of pore size and functionality in isoreticular MOFs
papers.source_hint: Eddaoudi et al. (2002) — MOF-5 CH4 storage at 298 K. BET=2900 (not Langmuir=4400). Hardest case: first-pass LLM often confuses BET with Langmuir.

papers.title: A new zirconium inorganic building brick forming metal organic frameworks with exceptional stability
papers.source_hint: Cavka et al. (2008) JACS — UiO-66. BET 1187 m2/g and Vp 0.40 cm3/g from Table 1 and SI.

papers.title: Selective CO2 capture by ZIF-8 at low partial pressures
papers.source_hint: ZIF-8 CO2/N2 selectivity paper. Multi-gas isotherm at 273 K and 298 K. Matches sample_ocr.txt in data/samples/.
